name: session-hud
description: Shows Compact, Handoff and Reflect above the prompt only when they help, each with the reason, and suggests the matching command. Reflect also shows when corrections pile up or a session runs long.

compactAtPercent.title: Suggest Compact at context %
compactAtPercent.description: Show the Compact button once the context is this full.

handoffAtPercent.title: Suggest Handoff at context %
handoffAtPercent.description: Show the Handoff button once the context is this full.

breakTimes.title: Break times
breakTimes.description: Times you usually stop, as HH:MM and a label, separated by commas. Handoff is suggested shortly before each.

breakLeadMinutes.title: Minutes before a break
breakLeadMinutes.description: How early to suggest Handoff before a break time.

longSessionHours.title: Long session (hours)
longSessionHours.description: Suggest Handoff when a session has run this long.

reflectAtCorrections.title: Suggest Reflect at N corrections
reflectAtCorrections.description: Show Reflect when correction-catcher's log has this many open items.

reflectAfterTurns.title: Suggest Reflect after N turns
reflectAfterTurns.description: Show Reflect once a session reaches this many turns and has not reflected yet.

correctionsPath.title: Corrections log
correctionsPath.description: Same path as correction-catcher's logPath. Open items here count toward the Reflect nudge.

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Notify after long turns (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Send a desktop notification when a turn longer than this ends. 0 turns it off.
